I have run into a problem using the latest version of GGIR (1.9-1). The data runs when: relyonsleeplog = FALSE, but i am running into problems using sleep log data.


I have tried to follow a number of steps on the discussion to resolve the issues i have encountered but am still running into problems, i have updated GGIR and all dependencies - install.packages("GGIR",dependencies = TRUE)


When running the .bin files (testing it with one or two) with the c:/ location sleep log we have been receiving the error:


Error in g.report.part4(datadir = datadir, metadatadir = metadatadir,  :
